# Easy Sweep

> A macOS menu bar app that reclaims disk space from Xcode, simulators, dev
> toolchains and AI CLI caches, and uninstalls applications along with the files
> they leave behind. macOS 14+. Free, with a one-time $9.99 Pro upgrade.

Easy Sweep finds the disk space development tools quietly consume in folders
Finder never shows — `~/Library/Developer`, package manager caches, AI CLI
caches — and lets the user delete it selectively. Nothing is ever pre-selected.

## Editions

- **Direct download** (recommended): unsandboxed, notarized DMG. Reaches every
  catalogued location without asking. Can remove an application bundle outright.
  Pro sold as a licence key covering 3 Macs.
- **Mac App Store**: the same app, sandboxed as Apple requires. Asks for home
  folder access once per section, and usually cannot delete another app's
  bundle — the user drags that to the Trash. Pro sold as an in-app purchase
  tied to the Apple Account, with no device limit.

## What it cleans

Five sections: Developer (Xcode caches, Derived Data, Device Support, simulators,
and 40+ package manager and toolchain caches), AI Tools (Claude Code, Codex,
Cursor, Windsurf, Ollama models, LM Studio runtimes), Browsers (page and script
caches only), Creative (Adobe and Ableton working caches), and System (macOS's
own regenerable data — aerial wallpapers, Music artwork, user logs — plus the web
and code caches Electron apps keep beside their data).

Excluded on purpose: lockfiles, SDK installs, emulator images, editor workspace
state, credentials, browser history and passwords. Those are not caches.

## Safety properties

- Nothing is pre-selected on any section.
- Refuses to delete any folder containing its own bundle; symlinks are skipped.
- Unreadable folders are reported as failures, never shown as empty.
- Simulators are deleted through Apple's `simctl`, never by removing folders.
- Sizes are allocated blocks, matching `du` — the space actually reclaimed.
- Uninstalls move to the Trash, so a name match is always reversible.
- The one-click clean can never reach simulators, archives or AI session history.

## Privacy

No analytics, no telemetry, no account. The free app makes no network requests
at all. Pro optionally syncs category and rule definitions through iCloud, and a
direct licence is validated against Lemon Squeezy. Scan results never leave the
Mac.
